validation_queries.description: Verify that rocSHMEM on-stream API name strings are present
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE string LIKE '%\_on\_stream' ESCAPE '\';

validation_queries.description: Verify rocSHMEM entries have non-zero start times
validation_queries.error_message: Found rocSHMEM regions with zero start times
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_rocshmem_api' AND start = 0

validation_queries.description: Verify that 'rocm_rocshmem_api' category appears at least once in regions
validation_queries.error_message: No 'rocm_rocshmem_api' entries found in regions table

validation_queries.description: Verify barrier_all_on_stream appears in rocSHMEM regions
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_rocshmem_api' AND name LIKE '%barrier_all_on_stream%';

validation_queries.description: Verify quiet_on_stream appears in rocSHMEM regions
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_rocshmem_api' AND name LIKE '%quiet_on_stream%';

validation_queries.description: Verify putmem_on_stream appears in rocSHMEM regions
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_rocshmem_api' AND name LIKE '%putmem_on_stream%';

validation_queries.description: Verify getmem_on_stream appears in rocSHMEM regions
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_rocshmem_api' AND name LIKE '%getmem_on_stream%';
